resources.string: Configure terminal, keyboard, gestures and advanced properties

Saved to ~/.config/termuxpp/termuxpp.properties. Legacy settings are copied on the first change; the original is kept. Clear a text field or select App default to reset a setting. Changes reload when returning to the terminal; some require a new session or app restart. Text fields accept the same syntax as the properties file.
Cannot read properties. No settings will be overwritten.
Property: %1$s\n\nUse the properties-file value syntax. Leave empty to restore the app default.
Allow external apps to execute commands in TermuxPP. Only enable this if you trust the apps granted the Run commands permission.
